items.detail: (a) docs/quickstart.md:23 — Hermes-plugin row carries the bold literal `**Hook-level command wrapping and limiting: NOT IMPLEMENTED (reserved byte budget).**` and explicitly states `the enforced / degraded / unavailable tier labels do not apply to the hook surface`; the same row correctly attributes command-size enforcement to the engine path (`HERMES_TERMINAL_JAIL_MAX_COMMAND_BYTES` … enforced at `intercept()`), matching plugin/terminal_jail/interruptor/__init__.py:123 (refusal reason 'Auto-sandbox skipped: wrapped command exceeds the configured byte budget') and README.md:515 ('Read and enforced by the plugin'). (b) ran `rg -n 'byte budget reserved' README.md docs/` — exit_code 1, zero matches (the bare phrase appears nowhere; quickstart uses the 'reserved byte budget' word order inside the bold NOT IMPLEMENTED marker). (c) `rg -n -i 'plugin' docs/capability-matrix.md` → zero matches: the capability matrix has no plugin row at all; its only `degraded` cells (line 55) concern filesystem isolation under bwrap/unshare/--user, and README.md:41/51 plugin rows claim 'Observability only'/'Does not wrap commands' — no plugin cell claims degraded. (d) ran `python3 scripts/docs-check.py` — exit_code 0, final line `docs-check: overall PASS`.
